newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Abbey, NatWest "baffled" by merger report -RBS.
newsitem.headline: Abbey, NatWest "baffled" by merger report -RBS.

text.p: The heads of Abbey National and National Westminster Bank were baffled by a newspaper report linking them in a possible merger, the chairman of Royal Bank of Scotland Group, Lord Younger, said on Tuesday.
Lord Younger was attending the International Monetary Conference where other bankers present included Lord Tugendhat of Abbey National and Lord Alexander, chairman of the NatWest Group.
Asked by Reuters whether an Abbey-NatWest link-up would make sense, Younger dismissed the report in the Sunday Telegraph which said the two sides had been talking about such a merger.
"We can find absolutely no reason behind that rumour at all. The heads of both organisations are here and they are absolutely and completely baffled by it," Lord Younger said.
"I do not know where it came from and I do not think it will come to anything." -- Stephen Nisbet, Zurich editorial +411 631 7340
